name: Sumeragi Kimiaki
source:
Kimiaki Sumeragi, a name that resonates as both a best-selling author and an illustrious detective, comes from a family steeped in nobility and distinction. His captivating appearance is such that it draws parallels to the timeless allure of ancient Greek sculptures. 

Adept in psychology, Kimiaki's keen intellect and intuition have solidified his reputation as a great detective. Yet, despite his many virtues, his individualistic approach to life often creates a barrier to forging meaningful connections with others.
